output_list.criticism: The function transfer() has a vulnerability of Integer Overflow. The function calculates the value of _value by adding the value of _value to the value of balanceOf[_to]. If the value of _value is greater than the value of balanceOf[_to], the function will overflow and cause an unintended behavior.

The function transferFrom() has a vulnerability of Integer Overflow. The function calculates the value of _value by adding the value of _value to the value of allowance[_from][msg.sender]. If the value of _value is greater than the value of allowance[_from][msg.sender], the function will overflow and cause an unintended behavior.
